business_summary: Asahi Intecc Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of medical devices in Japan, the United States, Europe, China, and internationally. The company operates through the Medical and Device segments. It provides guide wires, guiding catheters, balloon catheters, penetration catheters, microcatheter for endovascular treatment; gastrointestinal endoscopy device such as guidewire and dilator; and robotic system and software. The company also offers OEM ODM service services for medical devices; and medical and industrial components, such as wire rope, coils, coatings, tubes, terminal processing products synchromesh wire rope, cable rack, torque rope, mechanical polishing, flexible shaft, and option parts. In addition, it develops, manufactures, and sells ultra-fine stainless steel wire ropes. It serves office automation equipment, housing, and automobiles industries. The company was formerly known as Asahi Mini Rope Sales Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Asahi Intecc Co., Ltd. in July 1988. Asahi Intecc Co., Ltd. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Seto, Japan.
